briefs: C4 (solana.rs parser, phoenix.rs policy: E_SOL_MESSAGE / E_SOL_PROGRAM / E_SOL_ACCOUNT / E_ASSET / E_PRICE_BAND / E_SIZE), C6 (sol_sign_rescue: E_QUOTE_FIELDS), C7 (fuzz seeds)
references: solana/web3.js 1.99.0 (message compiler and Message.from as a second parser)

deskSol.role: desk Ed25519 key: Solana authority (Phoenix) and the desk's Orderly key

depositSol.role: a 1Click-style Solana deposit owner (rescue transfer target)

strangerSol.role: a Solana address the desk does not own (attacks)

key_note: Public test keys (Ed25519 seeds 0x07..07 desk, 0x09..09 1Click deposit owner, 0x0b..0b stranger; 0x0c / 0x0d seeds for a fake market and a foreign trader). Never fund them.
discriminator_rule: Anchor: sha256("global:<name>")[0..8] (checked for every pinned value)
desk_note: SolanaAccounts registered by the owner: the ATAs are derived from the authority, the trader PDA is the one the Phoenix SDK puts at accounts[4] of every order for traderPdaIndex 0
markets_note: price_e8 = priceInTicks * tick_usd_e8, where tick_usd_e8 = tickSizeInQuoteLotsPerBaseLot * 10^baseLotsDecimals * 100 (quote lots are 1e-6 USD). Policy.PhoenixMarket carries base_lot_e8 only, so the band check needs the tick size added to the policy (interface change).
rules: parse: legacy only (first byte < 0x80), header 3 bytes, compact-u16 key count, 32-byte keys, blockhash, compact-u16 instruction count, per instruction u8 program index + compact-u16 account indexes + compact-u16 data length + data; indexes inside the key list; no trailing bytes; anything else E_SOL_MESSAGE
message: num_required_signatures == 1 and keys[0] == desk authority, else E_SOL_MESSAGE
ComputeBudget: only 02 SetComputeUnitLimit <= max_cu_limit and 03 SetComputeUnitPrice <= max_cu_price, else E_SOL_PROGRAM
ATA: only create-idempotent (data 01), else E_SOL_PROGRAM; payer = desk, owner = desk (or, in sol_sign_rescue, the verified deposit owner), mint USDC or PhUSD, else E_SOL_ACCOUNT

Token: Approve(04) of a desk token account to the Ember authority; Transfer(03)/TransferChecked(12) into a desk token account; in sol_sign_rescue exactly one TransferChecked of USDC into an ATA created in the same message for the deposit owner, amount == amountIn (else E_QUOTE_FIELDS); other destinations E_SOL_ACCOUNT; other opcodes E_SOL_PROGRAM
Ember deposit/withdraw: accounts[4] = desk USDC ATA, accounts[5] = desk PhUSD ATA (E_SOL_ACCOUNT); other Ember instructions E_SOL_PROGRAM

Phoenix place_market_order: variant 02 (IOC) else E_SOL_PROGRAM; accounts[4] = desk trader PDA else E_SOL_ACCOUNT; orderbook accounts[len-2] in the policy else E_ASSET; priceInTicks present and |price - reference| * 10000 <= band_bps * reference else E_PRICE_BAND; lots > 0 and lots * base_lot * price <= max_notional_usd else E_SIZE

Phoenix cancel_all: accounts[4] = trader PDA; deposit_funds: accounts[4] = desk PhUSD ATA, accounts[5] = trader PDA; withdraw_funds: accounts[4] = trader PDA, accounts[7] = desk PhUSD ATA (E_SOL_ACCOUNT); any other Phoenix instruction E_SOL_PROGRAM
any other program: E_SOL_PROGRAM. Instructions are checked in order; the first failure is the answer.
code_choices: Where interfaces 1.5 leaves the code open this file picks: compute-budget values over the cap, non-IOC orders and forbidden opcodes -> E_SOL_PROGRAM (outside the allowlist); a rescue transfer that does not match the verified quote -> E_QUOTE_FIELDS.
